title: SUN-DSBO: A Structured Unified Framework for Nonconvex Decentralized Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
summary: Decentralized stochastic bilevel optimization (DSBO) is a powerful tool for various machine learning tasks, including decentralized meta-learning and hyperparameter tuning. Existing DSBO methods primarily address problems with strongly convex lower-level objective functions. However, nonconvex objective functions are increasingly prevalent in modern deep learning. In this work, we introduce SUN-DSBO, a Structured Unified framework for Nonconvex DSBO, in which both the upper- and lower-level objective functions may be nonconvex.
